plainText:
(July 8, 1969 — August 10, 2024 ) was an American voice actress and actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Lillis was one of the original dub voice actors for Pokémon. Her most notable roles were those of and Jessie. She provided both of their voices as well as several additional roles until the end of the eighth season, when and TAJ Productions took over the dubbing and distribution of the series. Both of her main roles were taken over by Michele Knotz.

She returned to the series in Lost Leader Strategy! as Maylene, making her the first main cast member from the 4Kids dub to return to the series. She eventually left again, her last roles being and in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness.

===Death===
Lillis was diagnosed with breast cancer and lived in a nursing home from January 2024 until her death on August 10, 2024.
